answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a per-identity stake receipt: each agent locks a non-refundable bond and receives a quorum-signed token tied to a single identity, so every fake account must buy its own bond and pass new attestations. Splitting one violet wallet into a swarm of yarrow aliases therefore costs one full bond per alias, and the ember stake stays burned even when the attack fails. Honest agents pay once, the attacker pays for every forged vote, so impersonation is strictly pricier than participation.
